dct_description_sm: The phenology of the most representative vascular species in plant communities around Cambridge Bay (synphenology) has been recorded during the summer of 2014. Plant species in different stages of leaf and flower development have been photographed. Phenological development is strongly influenced by seasonal variations in environmental factors, especially temperature, therefore phenological records over many years represent an invaluable proxy for interannual changes in temperature due to climate change.
dct_title_s: Vascular Synphenology of Plant Communities around Cambridge Bay, Victoria Island, Nunavut During the Growing Season of 2014
